capabilities: View folder contents as a gallery
extras: Click to Zoom Image is an optional premium feature.
problem: Users often struggle to quickly browse and view media files and visual notes contained within specific folders.

relations.evidence: High Compatibility: Includes a "Force Right" option to ensure the gallery icon plays nicely with other plugins that modify the file explorer (like File Explorer Note Count).

summary: A plugin that allows users to view the contents of any folder in the vault as a responsive media gallery.
